subject: Insurance
title: How Cat Models Work
description: A quick win: understand How Cat Models Work.

hook.text: Catastrophe models simulate 10,000 years of hurricanes, earthquakes, and floods on a computer.

buildup.text: Cat models combine physics, engineering, and financial data.

discovery.text: Three companies dominate: RMS, AIR, and CoreLogic.

twist.text: Models disagree wildly. For the same hurricane, one model might predict $50 billion in losses and another $80 billion.

climax.text: Cat models replaced intuition with simulation.

quiz.question: What do catastrophe models simulate?
options: Thousands of years of natural disasters to predict losses
